view.name: Player
view.description: Integrated audio player with cover art, playback controls, speed and volume, and a playlist of latest episodes.

regions.label: Centered H1 page title 'Playing Latest Episodes' plus uppercase letter-spaced text nav between hairline rules
Large square podcast artwork, seek bar with times, repeat/shuffle/speed, prev/play/next, volume slider, episode title, podcast, date and description
Scrolling list of latest episodes across podcasts: title (truncated), date, podcast name in bold caps, duration; current item marked with blue speaker icon

evidence.note: Seek bar with elapsed/total time, repeat, shuffle, 1X speed, prev/play/next circular blue buttons, volume icon + slider
Auto-built list of latest episodes from all podcasts; now-playing item marked with speaker icon; each row title, date, podcast, duration
evidence.quote: 420 - Rio Got a Parking Ticket in a Car Wash

evidence.note: Seek slider flanked by elapsed and total time labels; second volume slider without labels
Global top nav of the app's fixed destinations
evidence.quote: HOME EPISODES ADD PODCAST PLAYER TAGS SETTINGS

evidence.note: Blue speaker icon marks the playing row; treated as part of the queue's now-playing indicator rather than a badge

structure.layout: centered fixed-width page: big centered title, text nav between rules, then a single shadowed 900px card split into now-playing column (left) and scrollable episode list (right)

aesthetics.typography: Raleway throughout (50px/300 page title, 11px/600 uppercase letter-spaced nav, 16px episode titles, 14px bold uppercase podcast names, 12px dates); Open Sans for a few control labels; system sans for player times
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast between a light 50px title and small 11-16px body; hierarchy within rows by weight/caps (bold caps podcast name) rather than size

notes: PodGrab player page. Classic Skeleton-style blog look: huge light Raleway title, tiny uppercase tracked nav between #eee hairlines. Player is an APlayer/Amplitude-like card with drop shadow: left half square artwork (red diagonal-striped podcast cover), seek bar in slate gray with blue thumb, bright-blue (#00a0ff) round prev/play/next cluster, slate line icons for repeat/shuffle/volume, '1X' speed text in blue. Right half is an internally scrolling episode list with durations in blue-gray at right, titles ellipsized, current item marked with small blue speaker circle.
